reviews.text: My biggest struggle when it comes to makeup is eyeliner application, so I thought a stamp would be helpful. And I was right it has a beautiful brown color and makes eyeliner application quick and easy. It is suitable for people who enjoy more natural makeup looks, but if you want to make it longer or sharper it can also work great as a foundation.
reviews.zh: 我最頭痛嘅化妝步驟就係畫眼線，所以我諗印章會有幫助。我果然冇估錯，佢係好靚嘅啡色，令畫眼線又快又易。啱鍾意自然妝容嘅人用，但係如果你想畫得更長、更利，佢都可以好好咁做底。

reviews.text:
This is a life saver. It's highly pigmented in black and it stamps on super easily. There's a stamp for the left eye and the right eye on either side and the heart shape makes it super easy to apply. I will say, if you stamp it on your forearm like I did it looks like it runs but I promise you that when you stamp it on your eye it won't-- the wrinkles in your arm skin are just wider apart than the ones on your face (unless I guess you have super wrinkly eye skin?). I only planned to use this as a guide for another liquid eyeliner to simplify the process of winging out my eyes but I don't really need to back it up with anything. It stays well and the pigment is strong on its own. Plus, I have hooded almond eyes (I'm half Asian) and the shape works well for me. I presume this would also work great on monolids, as the curve is fairly shallow and the length is just right without being extreme, but I'm not sure how well it'd go on wider eyes. 

Bonus that on my arm it looks like angry little eyebrows.
reviews.zh:
呢個係救星。佢係高飽和度嘅黑色，而且好易蓋喺眼眶上面。左眼同右眼各有一個印章，中間嗰個心形令到整個過程好容易。我會話，如果你喺前臂上面蓋印，就會好似暈開咁；但係我保證，當你蓋喺眼睛上面時就唔會——（除非你嘅眼皮特別多皺紋呢？）。我本來只係打算用佢做另一支液態眼線嘅指引，令畫眼尾上挑更加簡單，但係其實我唔需要再加其他嘢做底。佢畫得好穩，而且色素本身已經好濃。加上，我有啲扁平杏仁眼（我係半亞洲人），而呢個形狀對我好適合。我估呢款對單眼皮都會好好，因為弧度好平緩，長度啱啱好，而唔會太誇張，但係我唔肯定喺眼睛比較闊嘅人身上效果點。

加分嘅係，喺我手臂上，佢睇落好似生氣嘅小眉毛。

reviews.text: I love this so much! I have always wanted to do eyeliner looks on myself, but drawing it on perfectly is just so difficult and frustrating. This stamp makes the whole process incredibly simple and beautiful. It takes literally seconds to get a perfect, clean shape. If you struggle with freehand eyeliner like I do, you absolutely need this in your makeup routine!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意！我一直都想畫眼線，但係要畫得完美真係好困難、好煩。呢個印章令整個過程變得非常簡單，又靚。只需要幾秒，就可以得到完美、乾淨嘅線條。如果你同我一樣，覺得徒手畫眼線好難，你一定需要喺化妝程序入面加呢樣！

reviews.text: i’m absolutely terrible at eyeliner. so I use this product EVERY single day. The line isn’t very sharp at the tip so I do use another eyeliner to kind of connect it to my eye and make it slightly sharper, but it cuts a solid 10% off my routine every day by helping my eyeliner be more even quicker. slight learning curve to it, but once you got it, it’s amazing!!
reviews.zh: 我畫眼線真係好差，所以我每日都用呢款產品。佢嘅線條尾端唔係好尖，所以我會再用另一支眼線筆，幫手將佢連接到眼睛，令線條稍為尖啲，但係每日都因為幫我更快畫得更均勻，節省咗我化妝程序嘅足足 10%。要學少少，但係一旦掌握咗，就好正！！

reviews.text: The Dezone Eyeliner Stamp makes creating even, sharp wings incredibly easy. The stamp is precise, quick to use, and perfect for beginners or anyone who struggles with symmetry. The liner side is smooth, pigmented, and long-lasting. It saves time, stays put all day, and delivers a clean, effortless winged look
reviews.zh: Dezone 眼線印章令畫出平均、尖銳嘅眼尾變得非常容易。印章精準、快捷，非常適合初學者，或者對對稱感到困難嘅人。眼線嗰邊順滑、色素豐富、持久。佢節省時間、全日都唔會脫落，一筆就可以畫出乾淨、不費吹灰之力嘅眼尾。

reviews.text: i have monolids and i ALWAYS struggle with eyeliner like no joke. i always ended up with goofy eyeliner but this made me seem like a professional doing it and i get compliments all the time!! i use it for my sua cosplay too!! ^_^ it is also waterproof but not so much smudge, it does smudge a bit, one time i cried for a hour and the eyeliner was still there!! i would buy again!
reviews.zh: 我嘅眼皮係單眼皮，所以我一直都好辛苦畫眼線，真係唔係開玩笑。我以前經常畫出怪怪嘅眼線，但係用咗呢款之後，就好似我係專業人士咁畫，而且成日都有人讚！！我仲用咗佢嚟做我嘅 sua cosplay！！^_^ 佢仲係防水，但係唔太容易暈開，佢會暈少少，有一次我哭咗一個鐘，眼線都仲喺度！！我會再買！

reviews.text: I absolutely love this eyeliner! The formula is smooth, richly pigmented, and glides on effortlessly without tugging. It stays put all day without smudging or fading, even through long hours and humidity. The precision tip makes it super easy to create anything from a subtle line to a bold wing, and it dries quickly without cracking. I’ve tried many eyeliners before, but this one stands out for its lasting power and ease of application. Definitely a staple in my makeup bag—I’ll keep repurchasing!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款眼線！質地幼滑、色素豐富，順滑咁推開，唔會拉扯。即使經過好耐同潮濕嘅環境，都可以持久貼住，唔會暈開或者褪色。精準嘅筆頭令畫任何嘢都好容易，由細細條嘅線到大大嘅眼尾都得，而且好快乾，唔會裂開。我試過好多眼線，但係呢款嘅持久力同易用性令佢突出。絕對係我化妝袋入面必備嘅產品——我會不斷回購！

reviews.text: I recently tried the DEZONE Liquid Eyeliner Stamp, and it’s a total game-changer! The stamp is adorable and super easy to use—it adds a playful, stylish touch to any look. The liquid eyeliner itself is smooth, richly pigmented, and lasts all day without smudging. I love the sleek packaging and the fact that it comes in a duo set. Whether you're going for a bold statement or a subtle accent, this eyeliner stamp delivers with precision and charm. Highly recommended for anyone who loves creative makeup!
reviews.zh: 我最近試咗 DEZONE Liquid Eyeliner Stamp，真係完全係一個改變遊戲規則嘅產品！印章好可愛，用起嚟超級方便——為任何造型都加添咗一點俏皮同時尚嘅感覺。眼線液本身幼滑、色素豐富，全日都唔會暈開。我好鍾意時尚嘅包裝，以及佢係雙裝嘅套裝。無論你想畫大膽嘅造型，定係細緻嘅點綴，呢款眼線印章都精準又有魅力。非常推薦畀所有鍾意創意化妝嘅人！
